# Tproger

> Tproger is a comprehensive Russian programming resource covering development guides, security research, AI tools, DevOps practices, and industry insights.

Tproger serves as a hub for software developers with in-depth technical articles, industry news, company profiles, and expert Q&A on programming, cybersecurity, testing, and emerging technologies like AI and machine learning.

## Key Topics

- Docker & Containerization
- AI & LLM Technology
- Cybersecurity & BYOVD Attacks
- Document Recognition & OCR
- Software Testing & Mocking
- DevOps & Deployment
- Confluence & Documentation
- Antivirus Solutions
- Web Development
- AI Agents & Automation
- Code Quality & Best Practices
- IT Industry & HR
- Security Detection
- AI in Education

## Core Resources

- [Tproger Homepage](https://tproger.ru): Main hub for all programming guides, development resources, videos, books, jobs & expert Q&A
- [Tproger Editor](https://tproger.ru/editor): Interactive editor platform with programming guides, videos, books, job listings & community Q&A

## DevOps & Containerization

- [Dockerfile Optimization Guide](https://tproger.ru/articles/kak-gotovit-dockerfile--bolwe--chem-from-i-run): Dockerfile best practices: multi-stage builds, security hardening & optimization techniques

## AI & Automation

- [AI Agent for Confluence Documentation Review](https://tproger.ru/articles/ai-agent-dlya-revyu-dokumentacii-v-confluence--instrukciya-kak-sde): Building AI agents for documentation review in Confluence: architecture, LLM integration & Jira automation
- [GPT-5.4 Release: Advanced Capabilities](https://tproger.ru/news/openai-vypustila-gpt-5-4--million-tokenov--upravlenie-kompyutero): OpenAI GPT-5.4 features: 1M token context, computer control & autonomous agent capabilities
- [Vibe Coding Without Deployment](https://tproger.ru/articles/pochemu-vajb-koding-ne-rabotaet-bez-deploya): Why AI code generation requires deployment infrastructure: limitations of vibe coding without infrastructure
- [AI in Education: Critical Thinking & Misuse](https://tproger.ru/articles/student-s-iskusstvennym-intellektom--kak-obezyana-s-granatoj): AI adoption in education: student misuse risks, critical thinking development & media literacy challenges

## Cybersecurity & Threat Detection

- [BYOVD Attacks Detection Checklist](https://tproger.ru/articles/kak-otlavlivat-byovd-ataki--chek-list-detektirovaniya-s-primerami): Bring Your Own Vulnerable Driver attacks: detection techniques, real-world cases & EDR bypass prevention
- [Antivirus Comparison Review](https://tproger.ru/articles/kakoj-antivirus-my-vybrali--proverili-3-antivirusa-po-cene--aler): Antivirus software comparison: Kaspersky Premium, Dr.Web & 360 Total Security analysis

## Document Recognition & OCR

## Software Testing & Quality

- [Static Mocks in Testing](https://tproger.ru/articles/pochemu-statichnye-moki-ubivayut-testirovanie--i-chto-my-s-etim-sdel): Why static mocks harm testing: ML-generated scenarios, MLOps pipelines & modern testing strategies

## IT Industry & Career
